name: codex-builder-companion
description: A project-aware Codex prompt companion with Local Advanced and optional AI Enhanced Prompt Intelligence, upgraded model selection, loading states, and refined sidebar UI.

enumDescriptions: Codex decides routine low-risk details but asks before broad architecture, major dependencies, destructive changes, or material product/security choices.
Recommended. Codex decides normal engineering details and asks only for major product, destructive, or architectural decisions that cannot be safely inferred.
Minimizes follow-up questions. Codex chooses most implementation details and asks only when genuinely blocked or before irreversible/destructive product-level choices.
codexBuilder.decisionAuthority.description: How much implementation decision authority generated prompts give Codex.

enumDescriptions: Target up to 3 likely relevant files. Best for small changes and lower context.
Target up to 6 likely relevant files. Recommended for normal work.
Target up to 10 likely relevant files. Useful for broader debugging or architectural work.
codexBuilder.contextBudget.description: Controls how many likely relevant project paths Builder Companion includes in generated prompts.

enumDescriptions: Local Advanced: requirement decomposition, constraints, implementation guidance, and acceptance criteria run entirely in the extension.
AI Enhanced: uses the ChatGPT-authenticated Codex app-server to interpret the request, with automatic fallback to Local Advanced.
codexBuilder.promptIntelligenceMode.description: Choose how Builder Companion interprets rough task requests before assembling the final Codex prompt.

codexBuilder.includeProjectBrain.description: Include a concise locally detected project-stack summary in generated prompts.

codexBuilder.includeRelevantFiles.description: Include a bounded list of likely relevant file paths in generated prompts.

codexBuilder.promptIntelligenceModel.description: Preferred model for AI Enhanced Prompt Intelligence. Auto uses the account default model.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check src/promptBuilder.js && node --check src/localIntelligence.js && node --check src/promptIntelligence.js && node --check src/projectBrain.js && node --check src/contextEngine.js && node --check src/sidebarProvider.js && node --check src/previewView.js && node --check src/codexUsage.js
